comparison.objective: Tool-less bracket installation, versus insert and tighten a bracket bolt with a confined-access ratchet.
comparison.physical_skill: Unknown hook/latch engagement versus thread capture, socket engagement, short-stroke ratcheting, and torque/seat control.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate needs all tool-less mounts engaged; PR requires bolt advancement, bracket seating, ratchet cycles or target torque, tool removal, and release. Some PR versions state live scoring is unqualified.
comparison.reason: Both secure brackets, but the tested physical abilities are materially different; the PR’s incomplete scorer qualification is noted.
